newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese sources expect major news announcement.
newsitem.headline: Chinese sources expect major news announcement.

text.p: China is expected to make a major announcement on a news broadcast shortly, senior Chinese sources who declined to be identified said early on Thursday.
However, they refused to say whether the announcement would be linked to rumours circulating in Beijing that paramount leader Deng Xiaoping has died, and gave no specific timetable.
"You must expect an urgent announcement on a news broadcast soon," said a senior Chinese source who declined to be identified.
Chinese sources told Reuters on Monday that Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng had cut short out-of-town trips at the weekend to return to Beijing to see Deng.
Reports, rumours and speculation that the 92-year-old patriarch's health is failing have swept Beijing in recent weeks, rocking stock markets in China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.

A Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman played down on Tuesday worries that Deng's health was deteriorating -- saying there had been "no big change" in his condition, but declining to say what would be considered a major change.
